name: Receipt Data Extraction
description: Extract structured data from receipt images using vision + JSON output
explanation:
This workflow demonstrates how to extract structured data from receipt images using Vision API and JSON output.

Key features:
- imageInput: true for vision capability
- outputFormat: "json" with complete JSON Schema
- Extracts: date, amount, currency, merchant, items
- Simple 3-node structure: Start → AI (Vision) → End

Use cases:
- Expense report automation
- Receipt digitization
- Invoice data extraction
- Financial document processing

The AI analyzes the receipt image and returns structured JSON data.
